title: Free, simple, nice
body:
Great for simple habit tracking. It takes a minute to set up and then just seconds to log habits. Also, the monthly and yearly panels provide a nice overview of progress. 

The only weird thing is that if you take a template habit (for example “💪 Work out”) and then rename it, the daily notification will still show the old template name. 

Thank you, Kevin!

title: Almost perfect
body:
I love this app - it’s brilliant

But I want one more simple detail 

When I choose how many days in week I want to make it, if it’s less than 7 it shows like weekly habit and if I make it 1 time a week it shows as 1 (1 week), or 6 time a week it shows as 1 too

I want to see how many times I made it in number even if it is not a daily habit (I make it not every day, but as much as I can)

I want to see not 1 if it is weekly habit, but number of my attempts, 3 if I made it 3 times a week or 6 if I made it 6 times 

When I look on week numbers and compare it with daily habits it seems to me so low (especially if it’s a new weekly habit, but daily habits now about 300 days in a raw)

It would be amazing If I can choose how to show my habit - number of weeks or days I’ve done when the days in week is less than 7 for the habit 

Thank you for your work
